snippet.title: A Cozy Slow Life with hololive Members! "holoVillage: Our Cozy Days" Official Trailer #holoindie
snippet.description:
holo Indie, the dedicated game brand for hololive production derivative works, is proud to announce that "holoVillage: Our Cozy Days" will be officially released on April 24th at 17:00 (JST)!

In this latest trailer, you can get an exclusive first look at in-game footage and discover the various activities awaiting you in the village.
Our brand-new key visual features Usada Pekora from hololive 3rd Generation, perfectly capturing the charming atmosphere of the game!

■ About holoVillage: Our Cozy Days
Farming, fishing, mining, crafting, housing, and dungeon exploration…
"holoVillage: Our Cozy Days" is a heartwarming slow-life game where you can freely enjoy your life in the countryside.

Experience a world filled with both relaxation and excitement alongside the hololive production VTubers, all appearing as adorable chibi-style characters!

■ Product Information
Title: holoVillage: Our Cozy Days
Genre: Slow-Life Simulation
Players: 1
Release Date: April 24, 2026, 17:00 (JST)
Price: $24.99
Platform: Steam
Store Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3856280/_/
Supported Languages: Japanese / English
Developer: Roboqlo (X: https://x.com/roboqlo)
Official X Accounts:
https://x.com/holovillage (JP)
https://x.com/holoVillage_en (EN)
Copyright: © COVER © CCMC Corp.
